scripts.build:unpack: npm run build && npm -w apps/desktop exec -- electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npm -w apps/desktop exec -- electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npm -w apps/desktop exec -- electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npm -w apps/desktop exec -- electron-builder --linux
scripts.postinstall: node node_modules/electron/install.js && npm --prefix tools/arch-lint install && npm -w apps/desktop exec -- electron-builder install-app-deps
